title: Spawning mechanics

sections.heading: Sources of spawning
sections.text:
There are five systems which spawn enemies. See the individual pages for further details.
• Physical spawners are destructible entities that continuously spawn hostile creatures when a player is nearby.
• Spawn points are fixed positions at certain structures and dungeons. Most of them are single use.
• Zone spawning is the repeatable spawning of creatures that happens as players move around.
• Event spawners spawn certain creatures when a raid event is activated.
• Forsaken Altars spawn a creature when a player makes the right offering.

sections.heading: Other interactions
sections.text: Player base is an invisible area created around most player-made structures that prevents creatures from spawning inside them (only affects event spawners, spawn points and zone spawning).

full_text:
Spawning mechanics

Sources of spawning. There are five systems which spawn enemies. See the individual pages for further details.
• Physical spawners are destructible entities that continuously spawn hostile creatures when a player is nearby.
• Spawn points are fixed positions at certain structures and dungeons. Most of them are single use.
• Zone spawning is the repeatable spawning of creatures that happens as players move around.
• Event spawners spawn certain creatures when a raid event is activated.
• Forsaken Altars spawn a creature when a player makes the right offering.

Other interactions. Player base is an invisible area created around most player-made structures that prevents creatures from spawning inside them (only affects event spawners, spawn points and zone spawning).
